findings.pdf_says:
OPEN statement ........ X
 OUTPUT phrase ........ X
  WITH NO REWIND phrase ........ X
 EXTEND phrase ........ X
findings.markdown_says:
| OPEN statement | X |
|  OUTPUT phrase | X |
|  WITH NO REWIND phrase | X |
|  EXTEND phrase | X |
findings.why_it_matters: In the PDF 'WITH NO REWIND phrase' is indented one level deeper than 'OUTPUT phrase' (a sub-item of the OUTPUT phrase, like 'FOR REMOVAL phrase' under 'REEL/UNIT phrase' above it); the markdown gives it one   like its siblings, detaching it from its parent and making it read as a separate OPEN phrase at the same level as OUTPUT and EXTEND.
